_fixture.WHAT_THIS_IS: A hand-built fixture in the SHAPE of a MobSF Android static-analysis JSON report. MobSF was NOT run to produce it. See 55-MobSF/README.md section 1.6 for why.
_fixture.WHY_IT_EXISTS: The two scripts in ../scripts/ must be runnable by a reader who has no MobSF instance. They parse a report; this is a report to parse.
_fixture.WHAT_IS_REAL: Every VALUE below is a real measurement of the APK named in file_name, taken on 2026-08-12 with aapt2 (build-tools 35.0.1), jadx 1.5.3 CLI, apksigner 35.0.1, unzip and grep on the analysis host. The package name, component list, flags, protection level, certificate DN and digests, file sizes, hashes, code locations, URL, and the OkHttp pin value were all read off the artefact.
_fixture.WHAT_IS_NOT_REAL: The report STRUCTURE — key names, rule identifiers, severity strings, cvss numbers, the security_score, and the exact English of each title — follows MobSF's documented report shape as closely as could be reconstructed WITHOUT a running instance. Rule ids in particular are plausible reconstructions, not verified MobSF strings. MobSF's schema also drifts between versions (see README section 3.9). DO NOT cite this file's rule ids as MobSF's. Read your own report.
